timing_definitions.full_command_seconds: Harness monotonic process-launch-to-exit wall time; same definition as prior runs; excludes shutdown and artifact hashing.
timing_definitions.bazel_wall_seconds: BEP timingMetrics.wallTimeInMs; may omit after-command publication work.
timing_definitions.complete_build_marker_seconds: Profile timeline timestamp of Complete build; not full process lifetime.
timing_definitions.analysis_seconds: BEP net analysis phase, including analysis reuse and its overhead, not a standalone cache timer.

writer-a.warning: Historical timings have a different binary, output-action state, preparation/order and OS-cache history; total delta is not an isolated optimization speedup.

reader-b.warning: Historical timings have a different binary, output-action state, preparation/order and OS-cache history; total delta is not an isolated optimization speedup.

limitations: Single observation per measured role; paired on/off order is balanced across two different worktrees, not randomized repeated sampling.
Two cache-off preparation builds excluded from measured averages but reported as consumed attempts.
Fresh server/graph each command; local outputs and disk action cache warm. No filesystem-cache eviction.
When native action-cache statistics differ, full-command delta does not isolate SkyCache overhead; setup and net analysis remain separately reported.
DIGEST_MISMATCH is a generic native entry validity failure and can include action key, input/output metadata, environment or salt; it does not identify a specific cause.
Profile spans nest and overlap; BEP phase deltas and setup time are not a disjoint sum of the wall-time difference.
GC pause sums omit concurrent collector work. Sampled PSS excludes filesystem page cache and VM overhead.
Historical before/after total-time changes include preparation, output-state, order and OS-cache differences; this is not an isolated microbenchmark.

execution_phase_observations.interpretation: Reader defers named pip module-extension evaluation until after execution starts; controls perform it before execution starts. Therefore phase timing differences do not map solely to action-cache checking. Named spans overlap; no isolated local cache validation/deserialization timer exists.
